mapper.select: SELECT latest_profile.first_name as first_name, latest_profile.last_name as last_name, latest_contact.mail_address as mail_address, latest_contact.phone_number as phone_number, latest_address.postal_code as postal_code, latest_address.prefecture as prefecture, latest_address.city as city, latest_address.address_line as address_line, latest_address.building_name as building_name, latest_address.building_number as building_number FROM users.user_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id) * FROM users.profile ORDER BY user_id, created_at DESC ) AS latest_profile ON users.user_id.id = latest_profile.user_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id) * FROM users.contact ORDER BY user_id, created_at DESC ) AS latest_contact ON users.user_id.id = latest_contact.user_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id) * FROM users.address ORDER BY user_id, created_at DESC ) AS latest_address ON users.user_id.id = latest_address.user_id WHERE user_id.id = #{id.value}
